results.title: Farmer records 12.5 kg Zucchini harvest with JPG through the form
results.expected: toast 'Harvest lot #N recorded'; lot 12.5/0/12.5; one BLOB; photo shown
results.actual: toast='✔ Harvest lot #14 recorded.'; stock=(12.5, 0, 12.5); photos=1; rendered=True

results.title: Negative harvest quantity in the form
results.expected: inline error; dialog stays open; no new lot
results.actual: error='⚠ Harvested quantity cannot be negative.'; open=1; max lot=14

results.title: Buyer filters Tomato with minimum 50 and selects lot #8
results.expected: only Tomato lots with available >= 50; lot #8 photo tomato_3.jpg rendered
results.actual: lots=[2, 8, 13]; caption='1 / 1   tomato_3.jpg'

results.title: Buyer selects lot #13 (seed lot without a photo)
results.expected: 'No photo for this lot yet', no crash
results.actual: No photo for this lot yet

results.title: Buyer enters minimum quantity 'abc'
results.expected: friendly error dialog, no crash
results.actual: ('error', 'Search', 'Minimum quantity must be a number.')

results.title: Escape in the New request form
results.expected: dialog closes; no request created
results.actual: dialog open=0; requests 9->9

results.title: New request form opened from a selected lot pre-selects its crop and unit
results.expected: crop Tomato, unit kg
results.actual: crop=Tomato; unit=kg

results.title: First text entry (Quantity) receives keyboard focus
results.expected: focus on Quantity entry
results.actual: focus is qty=True

results.title: Return submits the form
results.expected: dialog submits
results.actual: submitted by Return

results.title: Buyer creates 150 kg Tomato request from the selected lot (Return key)
results.expected: request OPEN, 150 kg, market 3, by user 7
results.actual: #10 OPEN 150.00 market=3 by=7; toast='✔ Request #10 created.'

results.title: Selecting the request lists only Fatima's matching Tomato kg lots and pre-fills the remainder
results.expected: lots [8, 13]; quantity 150

results.title: Allocate 150 from lot #13 (120 available)
results.expected: error 'Not enough stock… only 120'; nothing reserved
results.actual: ('error', 'Action not completed', 'Not enough stock. Lot #13 has only 120 kg available.'); lot13=(120, 0, 120)

results.title: Allocate 120 from lot #13, then the pre-filled remainder from lot #8
results.expected: remainder pre-filled 30; request FULLY_ALLOCATED; lot13 120/120/0; lot8 150/80/70
results.actual: remainder='30'; FULLY_ALLOCATED; lot13=(120, 120, 0); lot8=(150, 80, 70)

results.title: Confirm 110 of 120 without a reason
results.expected: error asking for a discrepancy reason; no receipt
results.actual: ('error', 'Action not completed', 'Please enter a reason for the difference (discrepancy).'); receipts for request=0

results.title: Partial receipt 110/120 with reason, then full receipt 30/30 (pre-filled)
results.expected: pending listed [(8,30),(13,120)]; receipts lot8 30/30/0, lot13 120/110/10 with reason; lot13 0/0/0; lot8 120/50/70

results.title: My Requests shows the request after delivery
results.expected: allocated 150, received 140; status shown per current policy (DELIVERED)
results.actual: status=DELIVERED, allocated=150.00, received=140.00; allocations listed=2

results.title: Request of 1,500 kg: allocate using the pre-filled quantity unchanged
results.expected: pre-fill 1500 parses; insufficient-stock rejection, not a numeric-format error
results.actual: prefill='1500'; ('error', 'Action not completed', 'Not enough stock. Lot #8 has only 70 kg available.'); lot8=(120, 50, 70)

results.title: Near-expiry spinbox 'abc' then Apply
results.expected: friendly 'Invalid threshold' dialog
results.actual: ('error', 'Invalid threshold', 'Thresholds must be whole numbers of days.')

results.title: Near-expiry spinbox '61' then Apply
results.expected: friendly 'Invalid threshold' dialog
results.actual: ('error', 'Invalid threshold', 'Use 0-60 days for expiry and 0-365 days for surplus.')

results.title: Valid thresholds 3/7 for Fatima
results.expected: only Fatima's farm; rows sorted by priority
results.actual: 2 rows, farms=['Al Dhaid Fresh Farm'], priorities=[2, 3]

results.title: Truncated upload rejected; corrupt BLOB fallback and next valid image
results.expected: truncated file rejected; corrupt image unavailable; next valid image renders
results.actual: upload=This file is not a valid JPG or PNG image.; newest=('1 / 2   corrupt.jpg', '⚠ Image unavailable'); next=('2 / 2   eggplant_2.jpg', '')

results.title: New process: buyer finds the GUI-uploaded lot and its photo renders
results.expected: lot 14 listed; photo rendered; caption 'zucchini.jpg'; stored bytes unchanged
results.actual: listed=True; rendered=True; caption='1 / 1   zucchini.jpg'; sha256 equal=True
